newsitem.title: Belgium: CYCLING-JALABERT WINS FLECHE WALLONNE CLASSIC RACE.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-JALABERT WINS FLECHE WALLONNE CLASSIC RACE.

text.p: Frenchman Laurent Jalabert surged away from compatriot Luc Leblanc one kilometre from the finish at the summit of a steep hill to win the Fleche Wallonne cycle race for the second time in three years on Wednesday.

Jalabert, who rides for the Spanish Once team, crossed the line about 18 seconds ahead of former world champion Leblanc. Jalabert's Swiss team mate Alex Zuelle edged out six other riders to take third place.
Jalabert, quickly tailed by Leblanc and Italian Enrico Zaina, broke free on the eighth climb of the event some 28 kms from the line.

The Frenchmen left Zaina behind on the penultimate climb 14 kms from home and were more than 50 seconds clear of a group of 20 riders at the start of the 1,300-metre hill, the Wall of Huy, which had to be climbed three times during the race.
World champion Johan Museeuw of Belgium skipped the Fleche Wallonne race, preferring to focus on Sunday's Liege-Bastogne-Liege World Cup event.
